verdict.rationale: The evidence shows machine-readable docs surfaces: llms.txt, an MCP docs server, an SDK-versions JSON file and .md mirrors of the API reference. None of these is a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent API specification, so they are adjacent to the story rather than the capability itself. Probes of common OpenAPI paths on the help-center domain all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The latest version of each Claude Platform SDK and of the ant CLI is at https://platform.claude.com/docs/sdk-versions.json, as JSON.
